mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rk_admin_session (admin_id, token, expire_at) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{token}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, admin_id, token, expire_at, created_at FROM rk_admin_session WHERE token = #{token} AND expire_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rk_admin_session WHERE expire_at <= NOW()
